author: Thomas Gray, Thomas Campion, Rainer Maria Rilke
title: Poems for the exercises
note: Gray’s elegy is printed from *Select Poems of Thomas Gray*, edited by William J. Rolfe (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1876; printing of 1883). Campion’s poem is from *The Oxford Book of English Verse*, edited by Arthur Quiller-Couch (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1900; printing of 1931), where it is called “Laura.” The two poems of Rilke in English are from *Poems*, translated by Jessie Lemont (New York: Tobias A. Wright, 1918).
